label: Finding shops
question: How will I find shops near me and compare prices with ZAYA?
answer: ZAYA is being built so you can discover shops in your chosen neighbourhood, see what they offer, and compare product prices before you travel. The shopping tools are in device testing today and not publicly available yet.

label: Checking stock
question: Will I be able to check what a shop has in stock before I travel there?
answer: Seeing what a shop has in stock before you travel is one of the problems ZAYA is being built to solve. It is part of the shopping tools currently in device testing; details may still change before launch.

label: Order and pay
question: Can I order from a neighbourhood shop and pay when I receive it?
answer: Ordering and payment arrangements are still being defined and tested — ZAYA is not publicly available yet, so no ordering is possible today. Write to zayaapp@gmail.com and the team will answer your specific question.

label: Hours and contacts
question: Will ZAYA show shop opening hours and contact details?
answer: The plan is for shop profiles to carry useful details such as opening hours and contact information. This is part of the experience in device testing and may change before launch.

label: Joining the pilot
question: I own a shop in Addis Ababa. How can my shop join the ZAYA merchant pilot?
answer: The merchant tools — sales, stock, orders and customer credit — are in device testing with Addis Ababa shops in mind. Email zayaapp@gmail.com with "Merchant" in the subject and the team will talk you through the pilot. An enquiry does not guarantee a place.

label: Daily shop tools
question: How do the sales, stock, orders and customer credit tools work in daily shop use?
answer: The merchant tools are being built to organise daily shop work in one place: recording sales, tracking stock, managing orders and following customer credit. The website's app previews show real screens with demonstration data.

label: Customer credit
question: Can ZAYA track what my customers owe me and help me follow up repayments?
answer: Customer credit tools are part of the merchant experience in device testing — designed to record what customers owe and help follow up repayments. Exact features may still change before launch.

label: Shop requirements
question: What does my shop need to use ZAYA — phone, internet, documents?
answer: Requirements are still being finalised during device testing. Email zayaapp@gmail.com describing your shop — its area, the phone you use, and how you record sales today — and the team will advise.

label: Delivery basics
question: How does delivery work — does each shop deliver with its own deliverer?
answer: In the current design, delivery is managed by the shop itself: an order is associated with the shop's own deliverer and completion is recorded in the app. It is shop-managed delivery, not a passenger ride service.

label: Deliverers in ZAYA
question: I deliver goods for a shop. How do deliverers fit into ZAYA?
answer: Deliverers — "Riders" in the Explore menu — are the shop's own delivery staff: the shop assigns and records deliveries through its tools, currently in device testing. If you deliver for a shop, tell us your situation by email.

label: Late deliveries
question: What happens if a delivery is late or the address is hard to find?
answer: Because each shop manages its own deliverer, delivery questions are handled with that shop. ZAYA's tools are being built to record delivery status so issues are easier to resolve. The delivery tools are in device testing.

label: Sending essentials
question: I live abroad. How will the planned diaspora service help me send everyday essentials to family in Ethiopia?
answer: The planned diaspora experience is about arranging everyday essentials for family in Ethiopia through local shops — real goods, delivered. It is planned only and not available today; we will share updates as it develops.

label: Availability and money
question: Is the diaspora service available now, and is it a way to send money?
answer: No. The diaspora service is planned and not available today, and ZAYA is not a money-transfer service. The idea is providing real goods for family through local shops.

label: Partner shops
question: Which local shops will the diaspora service work with when it is ready?
answer: That is still being defined — the service is at the planning stage. Follow the website or email zayaapp@gmail.com to be kept informed.

label: About ZAYA RIDE
question: What is ZAYA RIDE, and when will passenger ride booking be available?
answer: ZAYA RIDE is a separate future concept. Its service details are still being defined — no passenger rides or ride booking exist today. Delivery today means the shop's own deliverer.

label: RIDE or delivery
question: Is ZAYA RIDE the same as shop delivery, or a separate service?
answer: They are separate. Shop-managed delivery (in device testing) means the shop fulfils orders with its own deliverer. RIDE is a future passenger-transport concept whose details are not yet defined.

label: Account safety
question: How will ZAYA keep my account and payment information safe?
answer: Security and privacy are being designed into ZAYA from the start. Concrete account and payment protections will be published when those services actually become available — we do not promise specifics before they exist.

label: Data and privacy
question: What information does ZAYA collect about me, and how is it used?
answer: This website creates no accounts, and its enquiry tool never sends your message to the ZAYA team. If you choose "Review my message", the text — with contact details removed — is checked by an external AI service only to suggest a route; you decide whether to continue by email. App data-handling details will be published with the app's privacy policy. See the Privacy page.

label: Launch and cost
question: When and where will ZAYA launch, and what will it cost to use?
answer: ZAYA is being developed in Addis Ababa, and the customer, merchant and delivery tools are in device testing. We do not announce launch dates, coverage areas or pricing until they are confirmed — email zayaapp@gmail.com with "Launch update" in the subject to be informed.

label: Amharic and partners
question: Will ZAYA work in Amharic, and how can I partner or work with the team?
answer: The website is in English today; Amharic support is prepared in the design and will arrive with verified translations. For partnerships or work enquiries, email zayaapp@gmail.com — tell us who you are and what you have in mind.

label: Email updates
question: Can I receive launch updates by email?
answer: Yes. Email zayaapp@gmail.com with "Launch update" in the subject and the team will keep you informed of confirmed news.

label: Other questions
question: I have a question that is not listed here. Who should I contact?
answer: Write your question in the message box and press "Review my message" for a suggested route, then continue by email — or write directly to zayaapp@gmail.com or call +251 91 283 5922.
